full_page.content:
1927, August 23
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
St. Bonaventure's Monastery 1740 Mt. Elliott Ave. Detroit, Mich. August 23, 1927
Miss Mable Courtney Grace Hospital City
My Dear Miss Courtney:
It has just struck 10:30 p.m. and I perhaps ought to be slum- bering before this, but I want to do what I've been forced to put off thus far - write you a few works of encouragement, etc. I surely am pleased with words and reports of your now constant im- provement. I would like to have called to see you today but it was raining and when I left the dentist I had just time to get home for dinner. ... I hope you will continue to improve till you are back "on the job" again. Of course it is possible that you may be a little lame in that knee of yours, though we will hope for the best and leave it all to the divine Lover of our Souls -
Yes leave everything to Him - offering ourselves to Him to suf- fer whatever His love may permit. When I think of your condition for the first week or two it looks to me almost like a miracle that you pulled through atall. Thank God for it all! I am sure your sufferings were not lost, and that more than yourself have profited by them spiritually.
Now good night and God bless you: as well as all your nurses and friends.
Sincerely yours in Christ,
Fr. Solanus Casey, O. . M. Cap.
